_comment: Every agent the estate runs, and where it keeps the claims it makes about itself. An agent with no REQUIREMENTS.jsonl is certified as 'cannot be certified', which is a result, not a pass. Adding an agent here is the whole of onboarding it into certification.

agents.name: estate
agents._why: The estate itself is an agent, because the things nobody owns are the things that rot. Its first claims are about job monitoring: 46 loaded jobs, 12 wrapped, 34 bare on the day it was onboarded, including two backup jobs and the cost sentinel. A backup nobody watches is indistinguishable from no backup.
